caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, brown, wood-like case with a marbled texture and gold trim along the edges. There is a prominent circular gold emblem or medallion set into the upper left corner of the outer surface. The case is partially open, displaying the inside, which shares the same brown color and marbled pattern. Two smaller, monochromatic line diagrams are included: one in the upper right corner showing a closed isometric view of the case and one in the lower left corner showing a side profile of the closed case. The central case takes up most of the drawing, while the smaller diagrams are enclosed in their own boxes. The background is a plain beige or cream-colored paper. There is a signature in cursive at the bottom right of the main boxed area.
title: Pocket Case
